title: CD15 completeness manifest
description: The scope within which one named evidence graph is declared complete (specification v0.5.0-draft.3, CD15; Gate M). A JSON artifact outside OWL: it changes nothing about OWL's open-world reading, and it is never loaded as RDF. Outside the scope it declares, an absence question returns unknown (CAP-18). The fields are CD15's, and no other field is allowed: revocation and supersession are not representable in v0.5 (OI-21), so a manifest cannot declare them. Names are absolute http(s) IRIs or CURIEs with a prefix tools/ontology/manifests.py knows (bco, ex, cco, obo).

graph.description: The IRI of the named evidence graph declared complete.

organization.description: The Organization whose evidence the graph holds.

acting_agents.description: The agents whose authorizations, or whose acts, the graph covers. Each is judged by identity alone: a member is not the organization, nor the reverse (CD15, Agent).

act_classes.description: The act classes covered, each with every class under it in the asserted hierarchy (CD15, Act type).

end.description: The last date covered, inclusive. Not before start.

authority_sources.description: The authorities, or sources of record, whose records the graph is complete for.
